hero.subtitle: Beautifully designed celebrations, thoughtfully decorated for your sacred vows and grand celebrations across Kanpur & Uttar Pradesh.

about.title: Your Vision.
paragraphs: At Decoration, we view every wedding as a sacred cinematic canvas. Based in the heritage heart of Kanpur, our decor studio harmonizes centuries-old Awadhi and Vedic ceremonial aesthetics with the crisp restraint of modern architectural scenography.

From towering floral mandaps carved in gilded jaalis to ethereal candlelit tunnels and vibrant sunlit courtyards, we orchestrate decor that honors your family's distinct legacy with impeccable precision and regal grace.

pillars.title: Artisanal Floral Design
pillars.text: Sourced fresh daily—from Indian marigold and sweet tuberose strings to Dutch roses, carnations, and imported orchids, sculpted with organic mastery.

pillars.title: Royal Architectural Staging
pillars.text: Customized palace pavilions, scalloped Mughal arches, carved pillars, and geometric canopies engineered specifically for your venue dimensions.

pillars.title: Seamless Kanpur Execution
pillars.text: Rigorous production logistics, certified illumination technicians, and punctual completion hours before the first baraati arrives.

services.title: Bespoke Decor Services
services.text: From intimate traditional rituals to grand royal receptions, explore our signature event decor categories.

items.title: Wedding Decoration
items.text: Regal Mandap architecture, grand aisle walkways, varmala floral revolving stages, and consecrated havan kund sanctums.

items.title: Engagement Decoration
items.text: Romantic botanical backdrops, gold foliage hoops, neon love tokens, fairy light waterfalls, and modern cocktail stage sets.

items.title: Haldi & Mehndi
items.text: Vibrant marigold curtains, brass urli flower tubs, boho cane seating, gota-patti hangings, and sunlit courtyard lounge styling.

items.title: Reception Stage Decor
items.text: Monumental floral wall scapes, crystal chandeliers, antique gold arches, regal velvet thrones, and high-impact couple seating.

items.title: Birthday & Private Parties
items.text: Bespoke luxury themes, artistic balloon and floral arches, personalized monogram photobooths, and designer dessert backdrops.

items.title: Custom Event Scenography
items.text: Corporate gala evenings, anniversary feasts, cocktail nights, and experiential monumental entrances crafted with custom lighting.

process.title: How We Bring Your Dream Event to Life
process.text: Our three-stage curation process guarantees peace of mind and pristine celebration scenery.

steps.title: Share Your Vision
steps.text: We meet at your convenience or conduct a venue walkthrough across Kanpur (Civil Lines, Cantonment, Swaroop Nagar, or resort lawns) to understand your family rituals, guest flow, and dream color palette.

steps.title: Choose Your Design
steps.text: Receive personalized moodboards, architectural 2D/3D layout elevations, floral stem selections, and transparent itemized estimates with no hidden last-minute surprises.

steps.title: Celebrate Beautifully
steps.text: Our master floral artisans and staging crew complete setup hours ahead of time. Ambient lights are balanced, carpets steamed, and fresh blossoms misted to perfection.

contact.title: Let's Plan Something Extraordinary
contact.text: Wedding seasons book months ahead in Kanpur. We undertake limited bespoke commissions per weekend to guarantee our direct artisan supervision at every venue.
